claims.head: The Blues will send Fowler and Carlo at Eichel
claims.call: The Blues’ P2 (Fowler and Carlo) spends at least 50% of its 5-on-5 time against the Golden Knights’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Blues keep sending Fowler and Carlo out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Jim Montgomery has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Golden Knights’ first line is Barbashev, Eichel and Stone.

STL.head: The Blues have a hill to climb
STL.body: Even though St. Louis has home-ice advantage, Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blues can pull it off if they keep dangerous shots away.

VGK.head: The Golden Knights should have the upper hand
VGK.body: Even though St. Louis has home-ice advantage, Vegas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blues’ way back in is keeping dangerous shots away.

story.head: The matchup inside the matchup
paras: The Golden Knights come in at 8-3-0, the Blues at 4-4-1.
